description: Update a sending domain's tracking and inbound settings.

inputSchema.description: At least one setting besides `sending_domain_id` must be provided. Settings left out are unchanged.

auto_unsubscribe_link_enabled.description: Automatically add an unsubscribe link to emails.

click_tracking_enabled.description: Track clicks on links in emails sent from this domain.

inbound_enabled.description: Allow the domain to be attached to an inbound inbox as a catch-all.

open_tracking_enabled.description: Track opens on emails sent from this domain.

tracking_opt_out_enabled.description: Add the tracking opt-out link to tracked emails. Requires open or click tracking.

name: update-sending-domain
